title.narrative: 2025 CODE 1_IRC_Faith Movement for Gender Justice and Climate Advocacy

description.narrative: The Inter-Religious Council of Sierra Leone (IRCSL), with its extensive reach across the country, proposes to fill this gap by building a vibrant, national Faith Movement for Gender Justice and Climate Advocacy. The Faith Movement for Gender Justice and Climate Advocacy project seeks to address this gap by activating and empowering religious leaders and communities to become strong advocates for gender equality and climate justice. By integrating prophetic voice, advocacy, and community engagement, the project aims to dismantle harmful traditional practices, improve access to GBV services, promote women’s economic empowerment, and foster environmental resilience—all grounded in moral and theological principles.
